offer.title: Telegram Bot API Setup with Proxy and 429 Error Handling
offer.scope: A step-by-step guide to setting up a Telegram bot using a proxy, including long polling, webhook setup with HTTPS and secret token, and handling 429 errors. The guide will cover all the steps from creating the bot, connecting the proxy, running long polling, setting up the webhook, and ensuring robust error handling.
